g.text: Fixed primary query cohort · all five mechanisms
Primary denominator: 896 queries/world × 128 IN/OUT worlds (64 source groups) = 114,688/cohort/method/lag; every primary deadline precedes EOF.
MAE uses only queries answered by both paired methods; undefined errors are omitted. Deadline relaxation changes scoring, not the released stream.
